description: This file defines the SaveModuleConfigurationController class, which extends AbstractVueController. It is part of the OrangeHRM Admin plugin, responsible for setting up a Vue component named 'module-configuration-edit' during the preRender phase.

classes.name: SaveModuleConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller handling the module configuration save operation, setting up the Vue component during preRender.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by creating a new Vue component instance 'module-configuration-edit' and setting it for the view context.
